backup.production_rule: One nullable jsonb column on concierge_threads (booking_flow). No function, grant or row is changed. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: booking_flow_column_exists
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='concierge_threads' and column_name='booking_flow' and data_type='jsonb')

forward_verification.name: no_thread_has_a_flow_yet
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from public.concierge_threads where booking_flow is not null

rollback.safe_until: always (drops the column; any in-flight Messenger booking state is lost, submitted bookings stay)

feature_flags.name: messenger_book_intent
feature_flags.required_state: messenger-concierge v74 reads/writes booking_flow; until the column exists the upsert fails on a book intent (the deploy waits for this apply). concierge_mode stays whatever it is.

compatibility.evidence: Nullable column, unread by the deployed v73. Rehearse on Alfred before apply.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
